$comment: Lumens is a US furniture and lighting retailer on Salesforce Commerce Cloud with the Mobify/Chakra PWA storefront (window.__PRELOADED_STATE__), so the product page is a JavaScript shell: the PDP container arrives about 8s after the document and the buy box (price, add-to-cart, availability) about 3s after that, which is why fetch.engine is browser and pages.product.root is a :has() selector instead of the container itself - the browser engine snapshots the DOM as soon as root attaches, so root has to wait for the price. The site sits behind Cloudflare with an interactive Turnstile challenge that headless Chromium and Playwright/CDP launches do not pass; a real Chrome window on a residential proxy does, so the server runs this site with APP_BROWSER_HEADLESS=false and APP_PROXY_* set. pages.product.match is derived from the 61,644 product URLs in sitemap_0..2-product.xml: every one ends in a -<item code>.html whose code either contains a digit (ETH2111288, uu8935, PG94021, 101P552551) or is the letter-only Demandware id (PAAAAAABANBLOMBC), and one-page pages such as /careers.html or /product-protection.html match neither. Prices are in US dollars; a sale page puts the current price in .SalePrice and the list price in .OriginalPrice, a regular page puts the price in .price, and all of them live under [data-testid=pdp-price]. The description is only the prose column (.description-right), not the Key Features tiles or the Item Number/MFR ID row that sit next to it. Specs are flat rows (a heading such as 'Dimensions' is a sibling, not a wrapper, so no group is configured) and rows whose key is blank - Lumens uses one to say 'OK for Outdoor Use' - are skipped by the extractor. Availability is not configured: every product page sampled (in stock, made to order, clearance) rendered an enabled 'Add to Cart' button and no out-of-stock markup could be found to base a selector on, so an unorderable product is returned with its price and no stock signal rather than risking a false price.state out_of_stock. robots.txt allows product pages and sets no Crawl-delay; fetch.delay_ms only keeps the browser from hammering the CDN. Checked against the live N701 Round Corner Sofa (regular price) and Pismo Outdoor Accent Table (sale price) pages on 2026-11-12.
